_comment: For AI agents: create subjects with a nonempty subjects array. The UI assigns each subject an id automatically. JSON import also generates a UUID if id is omitted. Supply a unique id when preparing linked files: for example, set id to cpp-2026 here and use cpp-2026 as the subject field of a work. This distinguishes courses with the same title in different academic years. Existing ids are rejected. title, semesterNumber (1-12) and academicYear (current academic year or next three, September-August) are required. Colors: blue, green, purple, orange, gray, red, yellow, teal, pink, indigo. Icons: code, tree, wave, database, cpu, book, globe, terminal, chart, molecule. groups accepts ИВТ-24, ИВТ-25, ПИ-24. studentIds optionally grants individual access by student ID (student-anna, student-ivan, student-elena). Access is granted by group or student ID. Use groups: [] for individual access only. teachers accepts Ирина Волкова, Андрей Соколов, Мария Орлова; the current teacher is always added as the owner. description, faq and review are Markdown strings. Use UTF-8 JSON and no trailing commas.
